solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Former PM in the Commons perhaps lying in the past

parts.note: the House of Commons is an example of a legislative chamber, hence 'perhaps'
lain is the past participle of the verb to lie

explanation.surface: A recollection of some ex-premier telling fibs in the House of Commons years ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lying' suggests dishonesty, but it is lie as in recline, put into its past participle.
explanation.definitionFit: Neville Chamberlain was British Prime Minister from 1937 to 1940, a former holder of the office.

clue.text: Padre rejects a former film star

indicators.note: rejecting the letter means throwing it out of the word for the clergyman

parts.note: a padre is a military chaplain

explanation.surface: A clergyman turns away a faded screen idol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejects' removes the A from CHAPLAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlie Chaplin was a celebrated star of silent cinema, long dead and so a former film star.

clue.text: Female in a volunteer force is a goddess

indicators.note: in places the word for a female bird within the letters for a and the volunteer force

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A woman serving in the reserve army is described as divine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' does the placing. The Territorial Army is Britain's part-time volunteer army reserve; 'Female' looks like it describes the soldier but is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Athena is the Greek goddess of wisdom and warfare.

clue.text: Pussy Galore perhaps a slave girl

definitions.meaning: Pussy Galore is a Bond girl in Goldfinger, so one of James Bond's women
a woman held in bondage, a female serf or slave

explanation.surface: A Bond character is cast as a captive maiden.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the first definition as BOND'S WOMAN, a woman of James Bond's.
explanation.definitionFit: A bondswoman is a woman in bondage, that is a female slave.

clue.text: What goes with rock drummer's piece

definitions.meaning: the music genre is rock and ..., so the word partners rock
a drum ... is a rapid succession of beats played by a drummer

explanation.surface: Asking which instrumental passage suits a rock drummer.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll is the rapid continuous beating a drummer plays, and the partner of rock in rock'n'roll.

clue.text: One doesn't remember M. Caine as crook

indicators.note: crook as an adjective means bad or unwell, so the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Michael Caine cast as a villain who has lost his memory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crook' looks like a criminal role for the actor, but it is the anagram signal on M CAINE AS.
explanation.definitionFit: An amnesiac is a person suffering memory loss, someone who cannot recall things.

clue.text: Stocking material making a profit

definitions.meaning: fishnet stockings are made of a mesh fabric
to net is to clear a sum as profit

explanation.surface: A hosiery fabric that turns a profit.
explanation.definitionFit: Netting is mesh fabric, as in fishnet stockings, and also the act of clearing a profit.

clue.text: After drink feature long discussion

indicators.note: after puts the facial feature following the drink in the answer

parts.note: tea is a drink
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: Once refreshments are served, a lengthy talk follows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' sets the order. 'feature' reads as a characteristic but means a part of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A teach-in is an extended informal lecture and debate session on a topic.

clue.text: Axing unorthodox atom scientist

indicators.note: unorthodox means irregular, so the letters of atom are rearranged

parts.note: Stephen Hawking was a famous physicist

explanation.surface: A rogue physicist is sacked for unconventional ideas about atoms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unorthodox' turns ATOM into TOMA, followed by HAWKING.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomahawking means striking with a tomahawk, a kind of axe, hence axing.

clue.text: Nuts mixed up in a cult

indicators.note: mixed up says the letters of the phrase are jumbled

explanation.surface: Crazy people get involved in a sect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed up in' reads as being involved in, but 'mixed up' is the anagram signal and 'in' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Lunatic as an adjective means crazy or mad, as does nuts.

clue.text: Representative performance of 'Carmen' songs

indicators.note: a performance of the songs presents their letters in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A politician attends a recital of arias from Bizet's opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performance of' signals an anagram of CARMEN SONGS.
explanation.definitionFit: A congressman is a member of the US House of Representatives, an elected representative.

clue.text: Have beer 'n' play around — it's a man's thing

indicators.note: around puts the word for messing about outside the drink and the n

parts.note: to mess about is to play around
ale is a type of beer
'n' is a casual shortening of and, giving N

explanation.surface: Drinking beer and fooling about, said to be a typically male pursuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' does the enclosing; 'play' stands for the phrase mess around, and 'Have' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Maleness is the quality of being male, the essence of being a man.

clue.text: Appoint by way of token

parts.note: as can mean in the capacity of or by way of
a token is a sign or symbol

explanation.surface: Choosing someone as a gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: To assign someone is to appoint them to a post or task.

clue.text: What BP does is of no interest to teenager

definitions.meaning: BP is an oil company which drills or bores wells

explanation.surface: A teenager finds the oil company's work utterly tedious.
explanation.walkthrough: BP is British Petroleum, the oil company. 'Well' as slang for very is common British youth speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Well boring is drilling for oil, and in teen slang very dull indeed.

clue.text: Deer's rear

definitions.meaning: ... means at the back, as in ... legs

explanation.surface: A stag's backside.
explanation.definitionFit: A hind is a female deer, and hind legs are rear legs.

clue.text: Antisocial type to annoy cowboy

parts.note: a loner avoids company
to anger is to annoy

explanation.surface: An unsociable person sets out to irritate a cattle hand.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lone Ranger is a masked cowboy hero of American radio, film and television.

clue.text: Public schoolboy clutches saint from East European country

indicators.note: clutches means holds, so the schoolboy word holds the saint's letter

parts.note: an Etonian is a pupil of Eton, a British public (private fee-paying) school

explanation.surface: A posh pupil grabs a holy figure from the Baltic.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton College is an elite English public school, which in Britain means a private fee-paying school.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonian is the adjective for Estonia, a Baltic state in Eastern Europe.

clue.text: Source of oysters, holiday's food supply

parts.note: Whit, or Whitsun, is a church holiday, with the possessive s
a table, as in keeping a good table, is a supply of food

explanation.surface: Where shellfish come from when the holiday spread is laid.
explanation.walkthrough: WHITSTABLE is a town on the Kent coast in England famous for its oysters. Whit is the Pentecost holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Whitstable in Kent has been known for its native oyster beds since Roman times.

clue.text: Find fault with fruit — one mark on it

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above, so the first two pieces sit above the fruit

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
M is short for mark, the old German currency
a peach is a fruit

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a peach with a blemish on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mark' looks like a blemish but is the German mark, abbreviated M.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach is to call into question or challenge, finding fault with someone or something.

clue.text: Charlie tolerates alternative form of his name

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to have something, as in I won't have it, is to tolerate it

explanation.surface: A man called Charlie accepts a different version of his name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his' refers back to Charlie, so the definition is a short form of Charles.
explanation.definitionFit: Chas is a common abbreviation of Charles, the full name behind Charlie.

clue.text: Top-level communication is something selling well

definitions.meaning: a direct line between heads of government, like the Washington-Moscow link
a hot item is selling fast, and a line is a range of goods

explanation.surface: A summit link that is also a popular product.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotline is a direct emergency link between leaders, and a hot line is a popular product.

clue.text: What provides exercise to perform around a lake?

definitions.text: What provides exercise to perform around a lake?

parts.note: PE is physical education, exercise

indicators.note: around puts the verb for perform outside a and the lake letter

parts.note: to do is to perform

explanation.surface: Asking what gives you a workout when going round a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: PE + D(A L)O. Read as a whole the clue also describes a pedal boat, which gives exercise as you paddle round a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedalo is a pedal-powered pleasure boat used on lakes, giving its riders exercise.

clue.text: Ad-lib performance needs mostly to get better

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the verb loses its last letter

parts.note: to improve is to get better

explanation.surface: An unscripted show needs to raise its game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the final E of IMPROVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Improv is short for improvisation, an unscripted performance made up on the spot.

clue.text: Keep quiet about sign — time to provide impetus

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for silence goes around the others

parts.note: mum means silent, as in keep mum
an omen is a sign

explanation.surface: Say nothing about the signal: it is time to get going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the enclosure; the middle reads as a word meaning an instant, a neat hidden bonus.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentum is driving force or impetus gathered by motion.

clue.text: Still one mythical creature

parts.note: yet means still, as in yet more
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: There is still a legendary beast out there.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeti is the abominable snowman of Himalayan legend.

clue.text: Mineral one confused with garnet

indicators.note: confused signals that the letters of the gem and the numeral are jumbled together

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone mixes up one stone with a garnet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' scrambles I and GARNET together. Strictly granite is a rock made of minerals, but it is loosely called a mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a hard crystalline igneous rock quarried from the earth, loosely a mineral.

clue.text: Scotsman embraces queen from Asian country

indicators.note: embraces means holds within, so the man's name goes around the royal word

parts.note: Ian is a typically Scottish given name
a rani is an Indian queen

explanation.surface: A Scot hugs a monarch from the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embraces' signals the enclosure. Ian is the Scottish form of John, and a rani is a Hindu queen or a raja's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Iranian is the adjective for Iran, a country in western Asia.

clue.text: Giving affection, being very close

parts.note: handing means passing or giving
love is affection

explanation.surface: Showing fondness, two people are intimate.
explanation.definitionFit: Hand in glove is an idiom for being in close partnership or collusion.
